national_policy.name: NPPF August 2026 policy HC5 Hot food takeaways
national_policy.note: Takeaways should be refused within reasonable walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre. The glossary sets that distance at around 400 metres.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D (Newham Local Plan 2018 Policy SP9 adds takeaway clustering limits)
takeaway_school_rules.note: The Newham Local Plan 2018 has no school buffer of its own. SP9 allows no more than three takeaways within 400m of each other. London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D says A5 takeaways should not be permitted within 400m walking distance of the entrances and exits of an existing or proposed primary or secondary school. Emerging: the new Our Newham Local Plan got its Inspector's report on 18 August 2026 and awaits adoption by Full Council. Its takeaway wording was not checked.

takeaway_school_rules.schools: any existing or proposed school, plus local authority leisure centres
takeaway_school_rules.policy: Tower Hamlets Local Plan 2031 Policy D.TC5 part 3(d)
takeaway_school_rules.note: D.TC5 supports new A5 takeaways only where the proposal is not within 200 metres walking distance from an existing (or proposed) school or a local authority leisure centre. It also needs four non-A5 units between takeaways with a 5% cap in centres. The plan sets a local 200m boundary in place of the London Plan 400m default.

takeaway_school_rules.schools: primary, secondary and community college (supporting text also says college)
takeaway_school_rules.policy: Hackney Local Plan 2033 (LP33) Policy LP39 part A(iii)
takeaway_school_rules.note: LP39 permits new takeaways only where not located within 400 metres of the boundary of a primary school, secondary school or community college. They must also sit in a designated centre with no more than 5% A5 units. Paragraph 9.24 says permission will be refused within 400m of an existing or planned school or college. Emerging: Hackney expects a new local plan from 2029.

takeaway_school_rules.schools: nursery, primary, secondary, community college and youth facilities
takeaway_school_rules.policy: Waltham Forest Local Plan (LP1) 2020-2035 Policy 51 Hot Food Takeaways part C
takeaway_school_rules.note: Policy 51 permits new takeaways only where not located within 400 metres walking distance of the boundary of a nursery, a primary school, a secondary school, a community college or youth facilities. They must also be in a designated centre or parade. LP1 was adopted on 29 February 2024.

takeaway_school_rules.schools: any existing school, plus youth centres and parks
takeaway_school_rules.policy: Redbridge Local Plan 2015-2030 Policy LP11 part 1(b)
takeaway_school_rules.note: LP11 resists A5 proposals that fall within 400m of the boundary of an existing school, youth centre or park. It also needs two non-A5 units between takeaways. The wording is resist rather than refuse. London Plan E9 Part D also applies.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D (Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 Policy DME 3 part 7 adds assessments)
takeaway_school_rules.note: The Local Plan 2037 (adopted 18 September 2024) has no school distance of its own. DME 3 part 7 asks takeaway proposals in town centres for a cumulative impact assessment and a health impact assessment where appropriate. London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D says A5 takeaways should not be permitted within 400m walking distance of the entrances and exits of an existing or proposed primary or secondary school. The 2010 Saturation Point takeaway SPD is listed as superseded.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D (Havering Local Plan 2016-2031 Policy 13 adds clustering limits)
takeaway_school_rules.note: The Havering Local Plan (adopted 2021) has no school distance of its own. Policy 13 caps A5 at 10% of primary frontages with three other units between takeaways. London Plan 2021 Policy E9 Part D says A5 takeaways should not be permitted within 400m walking distance of the entrances and exits of an existing or proposed primary or secondary school.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: Thurrock Core Strategy and Policies for Management of Development (amended 2015)
takeaway_school_rules.note: A full text search of the Core Strategy found no takeaway or hot food policy. The council says the Core Strategy stays in force until a new Local Plan is adopted. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: Basildon District Local Plan Saved Policies 2007 (Policy BAS SH8 local shopping centres)
takeaway_school_rules.note: The saved 1998 policies have no school rule. BAS SH8 only refuses A3 food uses in local centres that harm residents' amenity. The council's 2025 NPPF compliance review says national policy on takeaways near schools reduces the weight of that policy. Emerging: a new Local Plan had Regulation 19 consultation from November 2025 to January 2026. Its takeaway wording was not checked. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

The adopted DMD mentions takeaways only in parking standards, with no school rule. Emerging: the new Local Plan Preferred Approach proposes refusing takeaways within 400m of a school outside designated centres. Cabinet backed a 400m approach on 13 July 2026 to inform that plan. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

takeaway_school_rules.schools: any school (measured from the school entrance)
takeaway_school_rules.policy: Brentwood Local Plan 2016-2033 Policy MG04 Health Impact Assessments
takeaway_school_rules.note: MG04 is not a ban. It requires a Health Impact Assessment for hot food takeaways that are not within a designated town, district or local centre and are within 400 metres of a school entrance. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

A full text search found no takeaway near school policy. Emerging: the Local Plan review to 2041 was submitted on 5 June 2026 with adoption expected in early 2027. Its June 2026 modifications schedule has no takeaway wording. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

A full text search found no takeaway near school policy. A5 appears only in the frontage policies PR8 and PR9. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: Epping Forest District Local Plan 2011-2033 Part One (adopted March 2023)
takeaway_school_rules.note: A full text search of Part One found no takeaway or hot food policy. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.

takeaway_school_rules.policy: Castle Point Adopted Local Plan 1998 (saved policies)
takeaway_school_rules.note: The 1998 shopping chapter only resists takeaways in small residential parades for amenity reasons. The saved policies PDF is a scan and could not be text searched. Emerging: the Castle Point Plan 2026-2043 draft Policy TC5 permits takeaways only over 400m from the nearest school entrance. That plan was submitted on 30 January 2026 with adoption estimated for November 2026. National NPPF (August 2026) policy HC5 also says takeaways should be refused within about 400m walking distance of schools unless in a designated town centre.
